title: BlockyOres
description: “Turns all ore textures into clean square-shaped minerals for a simple and stylized look.”
body: This resource pack redesigns many Minecraft minerals and materials with cleaner, more cubic and square-shaped textures while keeping the vanilla style recognizable. It changes diamond, emerald, coal, iron, lapis lazuli, and resin textures, along with iron, copper, and gold nuggets and raw materials. The pack focuses on giving ores and mineral items a sharper, blockier appearance.
